item.title: AWS Introduces Strands Decider 2B and Strands Box for AI Agent Development
item.description: AWS has introduced two open-source projects for AI agent development: Strands Decider 2B, a small model designed to make decisions within agent workflows, and Strands Box, a sandbox for controlling agent execution. (1 source: infoq)
